subject: Audit + access log handoff: export formats, retention slices, and deletion proof
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finvero.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan Liu <megan.liu@finvero.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clarification: audit & access log export capabilities, retention needs

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this on. We have a compliance ask from our legal team and need to understand a few practical details around Redwood's audit / access log exports:

- What export formats do you support for tenant audit and access trails (NDJSON, CSV, parquet)?
- Can we request an ad-hoc export for arbitrary windows (e.g., 2024-11-01 -> 2026-11-01)? What's the SLA for delivery?
- For customers in our EU tenants, can exports be delivered to an EU-only S3 bucket (customer-managed)?
- If we put a legal hold, does Redwood suspend deletion on the server side or do you provide an immutable export/manifest?

Also: we may need a signed attestation of deletion once the retention window lapses. Who should we loop in at Redwood to get the formal process / artifact?

Appreciate a concise runbook we can give the legal team.

Best,
Raj
Raj Patel
Head of Security Operations, FinVero
raj.patel@finvero.com
[FinVero]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finvero.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification: audit & access log export capabilities, retention needs

Hi Raj — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, followed by a concise runbook below. Looping Karthik for delivery specifics and Marissa for legal/attestation workflow.

Summary: we support NDJSON and Parquet exports (CSV available for smaller slices), ad-hoc window exports with a typical SLA of 5 business days, EU-only delivery is supported via customer-provided S3 (we encrypt in transit + at rest), and legal holds are handled via a preserved export + deletion attestation process.

Concise runbook (what FinVero can expect):
1) Request: open a support ticket (security-exports@redwood.com) with desired window, tenant id, preferred format, and destination (S3 bucket ARN or secure SCP endpoint).
2) Validation: we confirm scope and resident region within 24 hours and surface any cost estimate for large windows.
3) Export job: scheduled within SLA (default 5 business days). For very large backfills we may propose chunked delivery over a week.
4) Delivery: files placed into customer-managed S3 (if provided) or a signed URL for download. Files are compressed with gzip and include a top-level manifest.json (checksums + object map).
5) Legal hold / immutability: we produce an 'export-preservation bundle' that includes a tamper-evident manifest and a signed timestamp. We do not 'suspend' internal retention automatically — instead we produce and retain the export per the hold request and provide deletion attestation after the hold is released.
6) Deletion attestation: after agreed retention window, we provide a signed statement and SHA256 hashes of the deleted objects.

Attachments: Log_Export_Spec_v1.pdf (export field mappings, schema, sample manifest) and an example NDJSON slice.

I'll leave technical delivery details to Karthik.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finvero.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification: audit & access log export capabilities, retention needs

Hey all — quick technical clarifications: 

- Formats: NDJSON (preferred for line-by-line event ingestion) and Parquet (columnar; better for analytics). We produce a gzipped bundle with file naming: tenantid/YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_partN.ndjson.gz or .parquet.gz.
- Windows: arbitrary windows are OK; exports are computed from immutable write-ahead stores. For very large ranges (>6 months), we recommend chunking by month to avoid long-running jobs.
- Delivery: we can PUT to a customer-managed S3 (we require cross-account role details and bucket policy) or provide pre-signed multi-hour URLs. For EU-only tenants, we route the export job to EU export workers and the artifacts never leave EU.
- Legal hold: request a 'preservation export' in the ticket. We'll create a separate preservation bucket snapshot and a manifest with signed timestamps (RFC 3161 style timestamping). We keep the preservation bundle for the hold term in our preservation storage and provide access controls.
- Deletion proof: output is a manifest that contains per-file SHA256, record counts, and a signed export-id token. After deletion we provide an attestation pdf signed by our Legal Ops.

Operational notes: for production customers we treat export jobs as privileged ops — job runs are audited and stored for 90 days in internal ops logs. If you need longer internal retention for troubleshooting, say so in the ticket.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced in previous mail: Log_Export_Spec_v1.pdf]

Thanks — clear and helpful. Couple follow-ups from legal & infra: 

1) For the attestation doc: can Redwood include the export job id, timestamps, and a signature block that our counsel can verify? They prefer an export-id and a basic checklist confirming retrieval and hash verification steps were completed.
2) During preservation: will Redwood charge for storing the preservation bundle beyond normal export fees? If so, can you send the pricing/estimate model?
3) For EU tenant delivery: we need confirmation that customer-managed S3 in EU with a cross-account role is acceptable and that keys never transit outside EU.

If you can respond to (1)-(3) we can raise the legal hold request this week.

-Raj

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finvero.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification: audit & access log export capabilities, retention needs

Raj — answers inline: 

1) Attestation doc: yes. Our Legal Ops provides an attestation PDF that includes export-job-id, start/end timestamps, SHA256 per-file, total record counts, and a signed certificate block. We also include a short checklist indicating verification steps (checksum verified, manifest validated). Example attestation template: https://drive.redwood.com/exports/finvero/log_export_spec_v1#attestation-sample

2) Preservation storage: for short-term holds (<90 days) we typically absorb storage costs; for longer-term preservation we charge a nominal monthly preservation fee. I'll have Marissa send the pricing matrix (she handles enterprise pricing and SLAs).

3) EU delivery: confirmed. We only write to the customer-managed EU S3 bucket and keys are generated/managed by the customer. Our export workers in EU perform the upload — data does not leave the EU export cluster.

Next steps: Raj, if you want to proceed please open the ticket to security-exports@redwood.com with the hold flag + tenant id + target bucket ARN. We'll triage and set a delivery ETA.

Thanks,
Tessa
